inputs.prompt:
One continuous fifteen-second LIVE ACTION opera performance, same adult Celes/Maria as <Picture 1>, same real face, blonde ponytail and blue bow, ivory satin gown with blue trim and natural beige skin. Both hands have NO ROSES or props. Continue the EXACT approved P16 final frame: centre-right stage mark, gaze audience-left, right hand finishing its descent, left hand low. The supplied still defines identity and costume, never a pose to reset to.
0-3 seconds: let the preceding right-arm descent finish naturally, look briefly at that empty hand and draw it inward. Her right elbow bends and the empty palm gently rests over the upper bodice at her heart, fingers relaxed and anatomically separate. Eyes follow the hand before lifting again; a breath expands the ribcage. This is a private vow after the unanswered reaching gesture, not a repeated reach or another rose release.
3-6 seconds: her gaze chooses a destination a little SCREEN LEFT along the SAME stage depth. Head turns, shoulders and hips follow on a supporting leg. Her LEFT hand lightly gathers only a small existing fold of the outer skirt at the left thigh, lifting it just a few centimetres to free the heavy fabric for walking. The satin rises where the fingers actually touch it and retains its weight; no new cloth, pocket or accessory appears. Right palm remains gently at her heart.
6-11 seconds: take TWO short, clearly weight-bearing steps SCREEN LEFT, moving her hips about half a body width toward a new centre-left mark. Transfer weight before advancing each step, with natural small rise/fall and delayed cloth swing. The gathered skirt travels with the left hand while free folds trail and settle. Keep the same body size, head height and stage depth; body and gown stay BEHIND the existing foreground stones. Feet are naturally occluded, while hip travel, torso support and garment response remain readable. Do not slide, turn in place throughout or retrace the full previous crossing.
11-15 seconds: settle onto the new supporting leg. The left fingers RELEASE the small skirt fold; fabric drops a few centimetres and settles under gravity. The right palm separates from the heart and lowers into a relaxed open hand near the waist. Her head turns slightly toward the audience-left distance and her shoulders recover on an exhale. Continue these connected recoveries through the final moment, retaining the NEW stage mark rather than returning to the first frame.
Exactly one opaque adult woman and two anatomical arms/hands. No roses, stems, leaves, bouquet or grasping an invisible prop. Hands touch only her own existing gown, never enter the body, merge with fabric or brace on stone. Locked WIDE C_balcony audience camera; rigid blue battlements, moon backdrop and right red curtain unchanged. Neutral soft white skin/gown illumination, blue only in the set and trim, no magenta wash, flash or flicker. No ghost, duplicate body/limb, reset, stone penetration, scale jump, camera move, edit, fade, text or background intruder. Preserve the exact original source recording, level and speed. Do not invent dialogue or sung words. Natural breathing and resting lips over instrumental music; any genuine vocal onset belongs only to the supplied track. No new voice, music or Foley.
